verdict.rationale: Anrok is a sales-tax SaaS with a REST API, so an official CLI is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack documents only API endpoints, curl examples and agent-facing marketing ('hand it to your agents'), with no mention of a first-party command-line tool. Calling the raw API with curl is a user-side workaround, not an official CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
